And no external call to SCIS is declared from this service and no event is published or consumed by the branch

  Scenario: C8 The section 8 rules hold in the baseline document (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the business rules BR1 to BR4 and BR6 to BR10 of section 8
    When the baseline document, its consumed rows and its library elements are checked against each rule
    Then every operation, event and table is owned by its named owner under the Ownership Map
    And a consumed row with no published name carries the placeholder and its gap identifier
    And a minor version adds only optional elements and a removal, rename, type change or new required element is a major version
    And every consumed row is one hop with a 2 s timeout, a breaker and no chain, and the SCIS row is an activity on the owner's queue
    And the decision record and the rule package are referenced through their owners and no rule table is declared
    And the registration particulars and the submission reference are declared only once an owner names them
    And no personal data appears in any element, fake or example

  Scenario: C9 A consumed call that times out or whose activity is retried stays within its budget (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a consumed row of the baseline with its 2 s budget and its breaker
    When the call times out or its activity is retried
    Then the call ends within its 2 s budget and the breaker governs the further calls
    And the error set of C5 applies to the answer
    And the number of retries is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S5-E4028-CON-AC5) and is not declared here
